# Your Trusted Source for Security, AV and Smart Living Solutions

ADI is a leading distributor and solution provider of security, AV, and smart living products
serving over 100,000 customers worldwide. We offer access to a broad portfolio of products,
including top-tier distributed brands and our own exclusive brands.

With more than three decades of industry experience, we're committed to building long-lasting
customer relationships - making us a preferred partner for professionals across the industry.

# Our Mission

### We aim to provide products, services and software that help keep our communities safe, secure,
### comfortable and connected.

## Here's How We Do It

### Access to Exclusive Brands

We take pride in our exclusive, in-house manufactured products and software solutions, delivering
smart solutions that combine quality and innovation. From home automation to commercial-grade
infrastructure, we craft technologies that focus on what customers value most – delivering a
reliable and exceptional experience

[Access to Exclusive Brands]

### Support and Services

We offer a wide range of support and services to provide expert guidance at every step - from design
and configuration to ongoing support. With OvrC Remote Management, customers can easily manage,
configure, and troubleshoot devices across the network. OvrC is available on a range of exclusive
brand products and integrates with many leading distributed brands. Additional offerings include
systems design, technical support, rewards programs, training, project registration, and more.

### Robust Product Selection

With more than 500,000 products from over 1,000 trusted brands, ADI offers a carefully curated
selection of solutions to meet the needs for any application. We make purchasing easy - customers
can shop in-store or online and choose from multiple delivery options or in-store pickup.

ideal for compact audio systems.

# The finest Radio Frequency Heat Sealing Equipment and Warranty in the business!  

We specialize in manufacturing custom RF Heat Sealing Machinery and RF Welding Systems that enable
our customers to achieve their manufacturing demands.  From standard machinery to fully automated
systems, we can design the exact type of machinery you need to meet your product manufacturing
needs.  We are a family owned and operated company proudly manufacturing our equipment here in the
USA.  We offer the Best Warranty in the Industry and our Service is second to None.  For quality
machinery and great customer service, you have come to the right place for your RF Heat Sealing
Equipment.

 

## What is RF Heat Sealing / RF Welding?

Do you have a product that you need to fabricate from two or more sheets of plastic materials?  The
preferred method of sealing two or more plastic sheets of material is RF Heat Sealing or RF
Welding.  RF Welding can also be referred to as Dielectric Sealing and Electronic Heat Sealing.  The
sheets of material can vary from thin sheets to very rigid plastic products.  The RF Heat Sealing
Machine consists of a lower platen (sometimes heated) and an upper heated platen.  You mount your RF
Sealing Die to either the upper or lower platen to RF Seal your product.  When the machine is
activated, the upper platen comes down and makes contact with the lower platen and the die is then
activated with RF Energy to RF Seal your materials together.  The RF Heat Sealing Machine utilizes a
combination of heat, pressure and RF Energy to RF Seal your products together.  The RF Energy that
is applied to the materials in the shape of the RF Die, activates the polar molecules of the plastic
sheets of material, combining them to become one.  The result is a RF Seal that is stronger than the
actual material itself.

***Innovative Power Products*** has been designing and manufacturing RF and Microwave passive
components since 2005. We use the latest design tools available to build our baluns, 90 degree
couplers, directional couplers, combiners/dividers, single-ended transformers, resistors,
terminations, and custom products.

For us, “Engineering Driven, Customer Focused” is not just a tag line but the way we do business. We
continuously invest in R&D efforts, pushing our products to broader bands, smaller sizes and higher
powers to ensure our customers can create their next-generation designs utilizing the newest
state-of-the-art technology on the market. And our ISO 9001:2015 registered quality and Lean
Management systems assure our customers of a reliable product at a competitive price, creating a
winning situation for both companies while building lasting relationships.

IPP is an ITAR-registered company whose products are utilized every day in military, medical,
industrial and consumer markets. Our customer service team, sales representatives, and distributors
around the world are all available to help you find the right product for your application. This
support, along with our strong engineering foundation, dependable products, and fast delivery are
just a few reasons why IPP has become a market leader.

This website shows our most popular products with links to detailed mechanical drawings with
electrical specifications, performance data, S-parameters, and .STP files when available.

**Innovative Power Products’ Unique [Interactive S-Parameter Viewer][71]: ** This one-of-a-kind
online viewer allows you to scroll, zoom, point and select a sub-band. The viewer adds the
flexibility of showing out-of-band data as well as the value at each data point just by hovering the
cursor over the data point. Use the checkboxes to view individual S-Parameters, or choose to view by
groups:  All Transmission, All Reflection, All Isolation or All Parameters. You can view data in
Log-Magnitude view, as a Smith Chart, or as Unwrapped Phase.

At Innovative Power Products, we are always creating value for our customers.

## Wi-Fi, Network, and Security Services
* ### Business Wi-Fi & Wireless Networks
  
  Reliable wireless connectivity is critical to modern business operations. We design, install, and
  support secure indoor and outdoor Wi-Fi networks built for performance, coverage, and scalability.
  
  Our solutions include high-density Wi-Fi for offices and public spaces, long-range point-to-point
  and point-to-multipoint wireless bridges, cellular signal enhancement with repeaters and DAS
  systems, and IoT-ready networking for smart devices and sensors.
  
  From initial site surveys and network design to professional installation and ongoing support, we
  ensure your wireless infrastructure is fast, reliable, and built to grow with your business.
  
  CLICK HERE FOR MORE INFO
* ### VoIP Phone Systems for Business
  
  Clear, reliable communication is essential for every business. Our VoIP phone solutions range from
  simple hosted systems to full enterprise-grade deployments designed for scalability, redundancy,
  and advanced call handling.
  
  We deliver feature-rich VoIP platforms with auto attendants, call routing, voicemail to email,
  mobile apps, and analytics, along with specialized solutions including emergency 911 compliant
  phones, long-range cordless systems, cellular-enabled voice failover, and both coin and cashless
  payphone services.
  
  From design and deployment to ongoing support and management, we ensure your phone system works
  seamlessly across offices, remote staff, and mission-critical environments.
  
  [**CLICK HERE FOR MORE INFO**][27]
* ### Structured Cabling & Network Installation
  
  Need reliable network wiring for your business? We design and install complete network
  infrastructure and low-voltage cabling for offices, warehouses, campuses, medical facilities, and
  multi-building sites.
  
  Our team handles **structured cabling** from end to end, including **Cat6/Cat6A Ethernet cable
  runs**, **network drops**, **patch panels**, **server racks**, **MDF/IDF buildouts**, and clean,
  labeled cable management. We also install and terminate **fiber optic cabling** (single-mode and
  multi-mode) for high-speed backbones, long-distance links, and building-to-building connectivity,
  plus **coax** and other low-voltage systems as needed.
  
  Whether you are adding a few Ethernet ports or building a full network from the ground up, we
  deliver a professional installation that is standards-based, documented, and built to scale.
* ### Access Control & Door Entry Solutions
  
  Control who can enter your building and when. We design, install, and support commercial access
  control systems for offices, campuses, warehouses, healthcare facilities, and gated properties.
  
  Our access control solutions support key fobs, RFID cards, NFC mobile credentials, PIN codes,
  license plate recognition, and facial recognition, allowing you to manage doors, gates, and secure
  areas from a centralized platform. Access permissions can be assigned by user, location, or
  schedule, making it easy to grant, restrict, or revoke access at any time.
  
  From single-door systems to multi-site deployments, we provide professional installation, secure
  configuration, and ongoing support to ensure your access control system is reliable, scalable, and
  easy to manage.
* ### IP Cameras & Video Surveillance
  
  Protect your property, employees, and customers with professional IP security camera systems
  designed for reliability, clarity, and intelligent monitoring. We design, install, and support
  commercial video surveillance systems for businesses, campuses, medical facilities, and multi-site
  environments.
  
  Our solutions include high-definition IP cameras, secure network video recorders (NVRs), and
  scalable storage options with motion recording, AI-powered person and vehicle detection, license
  plate recognition, two-way audio, and remote viewing from desktop or mobile devices. Indoor and
  outdoor cameras are available, with options for night vision, wide-angle coverage, and long-term
  video retention.

## A One-Stop Shop For All Your Company Data Needs!
* COMPANY DATA
* AI
* B2B
* API
* REPORT

TradeAtlas’ global database provides the most up-to-date information about overseas importers and
exporters for companies aiming to make trade connections in international markets and monitor their
customers & competitors. The importers’ and exporters’ data on TradeAtlas is obtained from bill of
lading data and customs records. Therefore, all the information on the database comes from actual
and realized transactions.

[MORE INFORMATION >>][41]

With the Potential Importers solution, you can discover the companies that have not imported a
product or product group in the target market you have selected but have a very high potential to
import in a matter of seconds with nearly 100% accuracy. We provide the most suitable importer and
supplier companies for your export among millions of real companies via “Top-Matching Importers
Module” which is listed by evaluating many parameters such as import volumes, past import
transactions, geographical distance, import frequencies, interest levels and trade sizes.

[MORE INFORMATION >>][42]

TradeAtlas works closely with producers to promote their products internationally. We offer a
state-of-art marketing strategy powered by our own company-level data, which includes 20+ million
importers all over the world from 230 countries/territories, from USA to Papua New Guinea, from
Madagascar to Chile, from Yemen to the UK. We contact, negotiate and close sales for your products
on behalf of your company with our experienced team and dealers all over the world. Please contact
us for more details, including your products and website for a preliminary analysis.

[CONTACT US >>][43]

TradeAtlas features can be used through our simple REST API. Integrate with TradeAtlas API to
automatize your work with company-level international trade data. TradeAtlas API does 2 main jobs:
count feature (you can count how many Italian exporters are there who exports furniture to the USA)
and download feature (you can download all details of the Italian exporters who exports furniture to
the USA, including importer and exporter company names, prices, quantities, products, HS codes,
ports, and more, whichever available in our database). Please feel free to contact us for more
details, pricing, technical documents and a free trial.

[MORE INFORMATION >>][44]

TradeAtlas’ unique coverage of company-level international trade data, consists of 2+ billion lines
of transactions, could also be ordered via reporting feature (offline Excel/CSV files). Please
describe your need for trade route (for ex; I need shipments arriving to African continent from
EU-27 zone / or / all shipments leaving Chile to the world), product (for ex; I need all drug
shipments / or / I need all shipments under Chapter 70: Glass and glassware) and the period for the
shipments (during the last 12 months / or / from 2020 till the latest available data). Please feel
free to contact us for more details, pricing, shipments/company count and a sample file.

[CONTACT US >>][45]
